title: New license request: Autonomous Commons Dedication 1.0 (ACD-1.0)
body:
**License Name**
Autonomous Commons Dedication 1.0 (ACD-1.0). A successor text, ACD-1.1, exists as a separate file. ACD-1.0 is frozen and its text will not change.

**License Homepage URL**
https://yutapr0117-design.github.io/portfolio/LICENSES/ACD-1.0.txt (plain text, frozen)

**Reference URLs**
- ACD-1.1: https://yutapr0117-design.github.io/portfolio/LICENSES/ACD-1.1.txt
- Repository that applies it: https://github.com/yutapr0117-design/portfolio (see `LICENSE`, which carries `SPDX-License-Identifier: ACD-1.0`)

**License Notes**
- **What it is:** a public-domain dedication (Section 3) plus a separate, unconditional permissive licence (Section 4). The licence does not depend on the dedication being valid. It also has an explicit patent licence (Section 8). It places no conditions on recipients: no attribution, no notice, no share-alike. The closest existing keys are probably `cc0-1.0` and `unlicense`. The suggested key is `acd-1.0`.
- **Why this is requested:** without a rule, ScanCode 32.5.0 matches the text in fragments. One fragment is reported as `proprietary-license`, via `proprietary-license_544.RULE` ("Non Commercial"), on the phrase "for any purpose, commercial or non-commercial" in Section 6.1. That phrase grants permission. With `scancode.api.get_licenses`, the `detected_license_expression` for ACD-1.0 is `public-domain AND proprietary-license AND unknown AND warranty-disclaimer AND unknown-license-reference AND unknown-spdx`. A full-text rule would let the text be identified as one licence.
- **Status, stated plainly:** ACD-1.0 is not on the SPDX License List and is not OSI-approved. It was posted for discussion on OSI `license-discuss`, which is not an approval submission. Its only use today is the steward's own repository. If that is below your bar for adding a licence, that is understood.
- **Disclosure:** this account belongs to the licence steward. The licence text was drafted by an AI model (Claude) on the steward's direction. This request was written and filed by the same AI assistant, at the steward's request.
